scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @coopdigital/shared && npm run build -w @coopdigital/backend && npm run build -w @coopdigital/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @coopdigital/shared && npm run lint -w @coopdigital/backend && npm run lint -w @coopdigital/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @coopdigital/shared && npm run typecheck -w @coopdigital/backend && npm run typecheck -w @coopdigital/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @coopdigital/shared && npm run test -w @coopdigital/backend && npm run test -w @coopdigital/frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @coopdigital/shared && npm run test:coverage -w @coopdigital/backend && npm run test:coverage -w @coopdigital/frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
